scope: The maintainer-facing digest API of each pinned implementation ran locally. The 92 stored inputs are bare JSON arrays. CrawlCheck receives parsed arrays; addon-declaration receives the raw JSON in its tools/list page reader. Successful sides are matched on SRI, canonical bytes and SHA-256 hex. Error sides are matched on the spec error code.
finding: The two CrawlCheck SDKs pass all 92 vectors and all 43 digest pairs. addon-declaration matches 89 vectors and 42 pairs. Its whole-page parser rejects the three remaining depth cases before producing a per-side result. One equivalence pair is unavailable for the same reason.
